profile: release, lto=true, stripped
grovefs-mac: Linux build, fuser pure-Rust mount (macOS build needs macFUSE 4.x)
grovefs-win: Linux build, cfg(not(windows)) stub, no WinFsp FFI
what changed vs the previous drop (3bc087e @ kernel a8fcfae):
  * Mount bootstrap from a `grovefs manager`: --manager HOST:PORT resolves BOTH
    service coordinates from one signed roster, so an operator no longer hands
    out meta- and data addresses to every client machine. --roster-key-file is
    required (an unverified roster is an instruction to connect wherever someone
    else signed for), --manager conflicts with --meta-addr/--data-addr, and
    GROVEFS_MANAGER / GROVEFS_DEPLOYMENT / GROVEFS_ROSTER_KEY_FILE work as env
    fallbacks, item for item with `grovefs mount`.
  * A roster declaring MORE THAN ONE data server is refused, not mounted against
    one member. Client-side striping lives in backend::sharded, which is
    `native`-gated, so a remote-only build cannot serve a striped deployment;
    picking a member would hand this mount a layout other than the one the
    deployment declared. The kernel `grovefs mount` of the SAME roster does
    mount — the kernel repo's client stage pins both halves of that asymmetry.
  * --meta-addr/--data-addr became optional in argv (exactly one source of
    coordinates: both given by hand, or neither under --manager). Every previous
    command line still means the same thing.
regression: .build-bin/test_client.sh in the kernel repo, sections A–H, mounts
        grovefs-mac against meta-server/data-server built from the same kernel:
        both control-plane tiers (SQLite + PostgreSQL), the unknown-view and
        token-gate refusals, the Data-Access Capability handshake (with a
        pre-DAC negative control), fork/derived view kinds, --require-api-key,
        and since this drop the manager bootstrap (H: roster-resolved mount,
        five refusal shapes — coordinate conflict, missing key, wrong key,
        malformed key file, unreachable manager — the env fallback, and the
        striped-roster asymmetry). 54 assertions on this pairing, 55 with the
        negative control.
